lines.text: David calls blessed the one whose transgressions are forgiven and whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him.
While David kept silent, his bones became brittle, and his strength was drained as in the winter cold.
David acknowledged his sin to the LORD and did not hide his iniquity, and the LORD forgave him.
David says the godly should pray while the LORD may be found, and the LORD surrounds him with songs of mourning.
The psalm warns against being like the horse or mule, and says loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
